punchline: Bell Labs' top inventors often ate with the man who asked questions.
thirty_sec: Bell Labs patent lawyers tried to explain why some staff were far more productive. According to Jon Gertner, the common thread was that the top patent holders often shared breakfast or lunch with engineer Harry Nyquist, who drew people out by asking good questions.
question: Who around you has a problem right now, and which question could you ask instead of offering your solution?
key_contrast: He did not give ideas, he asked questions.
